name: player_find_alt_gun_fire_controller_for_weapon_id
description: Player::FindAltGunFireControllerForWeaponId resolves an OptCatalog weapon id to the first matching alternate gun controller and falls back to bank 1 controller A.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent Player/GameNet weapon-dispatch source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43c9c0 validates saveState/playerState access, OptCatalog::FindEntryById lookup, scanning alternate weapon banks 2 through 9, controller A priority over controller B within a bank, and fallback to bank 1 controller A when no match is found.
The native alt-gun controller smoke verifies controller A lookup, controller B lookup, controller A priority when both sides match, and fallback to bank 1 controller A for a missing OptCatalog entry.
